articles.summary: The corporate assembly of Equinor ASA has on 8 June 2026 elected Jarle Roth as new chair of the board of directors of Equinor ASA.

articles.summary: Equinor and its partners are investing just over NOK 4 billion in a new subsea development that will increase gas production from the Troll field.

articles.summary: Equinor and Vår Energi have agreed to a swap of assets on the Norwegian continental shelf (NCS). The transaction enables further maturation of the Peon gas discovery towards development and strengthens Equinor’s position in the Troll-Fram area.
articles.title: Equinor and Vår Energi agree asset swap in Troll and Gjøa areas
